title: Create: Dynamic Village — village pool settings
description: Scales how many custom buildings one village pool receives. Place at data/<ns>/dynamicvillage/pools/<pool_path>.json, where the file's own id mirrors the pool it tunes (pool ns:path -> file data/ns/dynamicvillage/pools/path.json).

weight_multiplier.description: Scales this pool's custom-building budget. 1.0 = unchanged, 2.0 = twice as many, 0 = none. Multiplies with the end user's per-biome config setting.

conditions.description: Optional load conditions; ALL must be met or these settings are ignored.
